6.89 rsInvalidMatrixSubtotalReportItem
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
rsInvalidMatrixSubtotalReportItem is a critical error that will occur if a Subtotal.ReportItems element
contains more than one Textbox element.
